newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy budget debate slips to Friday in Chamber.
newsitem.headline: Italy budget debate slips to Friday in Chamber.

text.p: Debate on the Italian government's 1997 budget will start in the Chamber of Deputies on Friday instead of Thursday, political parties leaders in the lower house said.
They announced the change late on Tuesday. The Chamber is still due to begin examining hundreds of budget amendments presented by opposition parties as scheduled on Monday.

The budget, which aims to slash 62.5 trillion lire ($41.1 billion) off next year's deficit, is due to complete its passage through the Chamber by November 14 and then to pass to the Senate (upper house). It must be ratified by both houses by the year-end. ($1=1520 Lire)
